prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1346; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by your insured's vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative of your company has provided a statement or made contact with our client, please inform us promptly.

We request that you disclose the policy limits of all liability coverage applicable to your insured for this loss. Please provide written confirmation of those limits along with the declarations page for the policy in force on the date of the accident.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and telematics, dashcam or surveillance footage, claim file notes, recorded statements, repair and appraisal records, and any other documents or electronic data in your possession or control. Please ensure that no such material is altered, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.
